parts.name: Forearm frame
parts.description: The main support structure beneath the wrist. It holds the hand assembly and provides the mechanical foundation for the base components.

parts.name: Forearm housing
parts.description: The outer enclosure around the base. Hide this piece to inspect the supporting frame and the components packaged inside it.

parts.name: Orca wordmark
parts.description: The separate lettering mesh on the forearm housing. This is a visual identity component and shares the fixed tower link.

parts.name: Cooling fans
parts.description: The fan assembly packaged in the forearm. Fans circulate air to help remove heat from the enclosed hardware. Individual fan blades and motors are not separately modeled.

parts.name: U2D2 interface board
parts.description: The communication interface included in the extended model. This mesh represents the board assembly; its individual electronic components are not independently selectable.

parts.name: Camera assembly
parts.description: The camera and mounting assembly included in the extended model. Its placement is fixed relative to the forearm, so it stays with the base as the wrist moves.

parts.name: Palm frame
parts.description: The central structural body of the hand. It connects the wrist to all five finger chains and carries their joint attachment points.

parts.name: Palm skin
parts.description: The outer contact surface over the palm. Removing it reveals the structural palm mesh beneath.

parts.name: Thumb metacarpal
parts.description: The base segment connecting this digit to the palm. It supports the joint chain that positions the finger.

parts.name: Thumb proximal phalanx
parts.description: The first long segment of the digit. It transfers motion from the base toward the outer finger segments.

parts.name: Thumb intermediate phalanx
parts.description: The next segment toward the fingertip. Its joint allows the outer finger to bend relative to the proximal segment.

parts.name: Thumb intermediate phalanx skin
parts.description: The contact covering over the thumb intermediate phalanx. It is attached to the same rigid link as the underlying segment and moves with it.

parts.name: Thumb distal phalanx
parts.description: The final modeled structural segment of the thumb. It carries the thumb tip and follows the distal joint.

parts.name: Thumb distal phalanx skin
parts.description: The contact covering over the thumb distal phalanx. It is attached to the same rigid link as the underlying segment and moves with it.
